name: Sales trend analysis
description: Find patterns in sales across products, regions, and time.
example: Compare monthly sales by product to identify seasonal demand.

name: Customer segmentation
description: Group customers by relevant purchase behavior.
example: Compare repeat customers with first-time buyers using purchase frequency.

name: Data quality review
description: Check business records for missing values and inconsistent formats.
example: Review a customer export for duplicate records and missing account IDs.

name: Inventory analysis
description: Review stock movements and replenishment patterns.
example: Compare stock levels with recent demand before planning a reorder.

name: Financial reporting analysis
description: Organize financial measures into a consistent reporting view.
example: Compare budgeted expenses with recorded spending by department.

name: Executive overview dashboard
description: Bring leadership measures into one readable overview.
benefit: Keep decisions tied to shared measures.
example: Display revenue, orders, and operating costs with agreed definitions.

name: Sales performance dashboard
description: Track sales activity against business targets.
example: Compare monthly revenue with targets and filter by product group.

name: Operations dashboard
description: Monitor workload, completion, and operational bottlenecks.
benefit: Prioritize the work that needs attention.
example: Show open jobs, completed tasks, and average turnaround time.

name: Marketing dashboard
description: Connect campaign activity with relevant outcomes.
example: Display visits and inquiries by campaign with clear attribution limits.

name: Customer support dashboard
description: Summarize support volume and response patterns.
example: Compare incoming tickets, resolution time, and outstanding requests.

name: AI opportunity assessment
description: Review repeatable tasks for practical AI opportunities.
example: Evaluate whether drafting internal summaries could reduce repetitive work.

name: Workflow automation planning
description: Map a process before introducing AI-assisted steps.
example: Map intake, classification, and approval for incoming service requests.

name: Document summary pilot
description: Plan an AI-assisted summary process with review checkpoints.
benefit: Make lengthy information easier to review.
example: Test summaries of nonconfidential meeting notes against the originals.

name: Knowledge assistant planning
description: Define a searchable internal knowledge assistant scope.
example: Plan answers grounded in approved operating procedures with source references.

name: Responsible AI readiness review
description: Review data handling, output checks, and oversight needs.
benefit: Set clear responsibilities before a pilot.
example: Agree on permitted inputs, reviewer roles, and how errors will be recorded.
